title: film director from NY, based worldwide, filmed mood videos, video clips, personal videos, commercials
bio:
Born and raised in Bethlehem Pennsylvania, Jonah George is a self taught commercial, narrative, and music video director whos work is inspired by nostalgic moments from real life. He started creating video at the age of 5 when receiving a VHS camera as a gift from his parents. From there he began his work in the music industry capturing music tours and soon after that began directing for artists. Currently he's focused on commercial campaigns and documentary work.

Jonah George is focused on the efficient execution of creative ideas for brands, artists and narrative projects. He has eight years of professional experience in directing, creative producing and cinematography. Favoring shooting on location, Jonah's started in the United states but is currently working on projects worldwide with production experience in 26 countries worldwide.

Clients: Nike. Omega. Sony Music. Givenchy. UMG. Kasina. Coach. Play Station. Backbone. Lauv. Paul Mitchell. Starface. Jeremy Zucker. ayokay. and more
